subject: Private Stack: starter commitment, support bands, and failover credit request
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@helixtx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Private Stack: starter commitment, support bands, and failover credit request

Jordan —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Following up with a concise starter proposal so we can align on commercial structure and next steps:

Summary proposal (starter kit)
- Commitment: 6-month pilot, reserved 4 nodes (dedicated on-prem operator licenses) + optional burst capacity for cloud failover.
- Platform fee: flat monthly platform fee for private control plane and observability (we've proposed $12k/mo for starter).
- Support bands: Standard (business hours, 8x5) vs Enhanced (24x7 SRE on-call). Options and incremental monthly uplift listed in attached SOW.
- Failover credit: Because Helix is asking for hybrid failover (cloud burst to Redwood Hosted), we propose a one-time "failover credit" to cover orchestration & testing — 20% credit off first-month platform fee if you sign within 30 days.

Open items we need from you to finalize pricing:
1) Operator seat count: confirm whether 4 nodes maps to 4 operator seats for you or if you prefer site-based licensing.
2) Expected steady-state qps and burst profile (tokens/day) so we can size cloud burst and cost-share appropriately.
3) Any legal redlines to the MSA we should review up front — I attached our SOW and the MSA we typically start from.

Next steps
- If the starter structure above looks acceptable, Marissa will share explicit tiered pricing and a short trade-off matrix (operator vs site seat, support band uplifts, and exact failover credit mechanics).
- We can target a commercial LOI by 12/20 so engineering can schedule an onboarding window in January.

Attachments: SOW-Helix-starter-kit-v1.docx (pricing appendix), Helix-MSA-redlines.pdf (placeholder for their markups).

Appreciate a quick note back with the answers above — I know procurement is on a tight timeline.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@helixtx.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helix Procurement <procurement@helixtx.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 14:01:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Private Stack: starter commitment, support bands, and failover credit request

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear note and the SOW. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Operator seats: We map operator seats to clusters. For the pilot we'll start with 3 clusters (staging, prod-canary, prod) but the prod cluster has most of the workload. If the license is per-node, we expect to need 6 operator seats initially. If you have a site-license alternative for a single datacenter, that could be preferable.

2) Burst profile: Expected steady-state is ~1.2M tokens/day with spikes to ~3.8M during batch jobs. We will provide a traffic sample tomorrow.

3) Failover credit mechanics: The credit sounds reasonable. Can you confirm it only applies if we execute the SOW (not just the LOI), and whether the credit applies to the first invoice only or spreads across the first 3 months?

Finally, Helix Procurement would like to request a 15% discount on the platform fee for the pilot as part of the case study commitment (we can provide a short co-marketing quote). Would Redwood consider that in conjunction with the failover credit?

Jordan
Jordan Price
Director, Cloud Platform — Helix Therapeutics
jordan.price@helixtx.com
+1 (617) 555-0456

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@helixtx.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Private Stack: starter commitment, support bands, and failover credit request

Jordan — thanks for the fast reply and the numbers. Short answers below and a couple of pricing options so you can pick the right trade-off.

Operator licensing: two options- Per-node operator seat (recommended if you expect node churn or multi-site): pilot price = $4,000/node/month (4-node reserved example = $16k/mo).- Site license (single DC footprint): fixed $28,000/month for unlimited operators within the site (good for scale predictability).

Support band uplift- Standard (8x5): +0%
- Enhanced (24x7 SRE): +22% of platform fee (includes 1 on-call rotation and 24/7 incident triage).

Failover credit mechanics- We can confirm: credit applies only on executed SOW invoices. Options:
  A) One-time 100% credit of the first-month platform fee (applies only to platform fee, not operator license) if SOW executed within 30 days.
  B) 50% credit applied across first 3 invoices (spread credit) if Helix requests additional professional services onboarding during pilot.

Discount request
- We can accommodate a 12% pilot discount on platform fee aligned to the case study commitment and a co-marketing blurb. To meet Helix's 15% ask we could: 12% standard pilot discount + a 3% early-payment incentive (net 15% if paid within 15 days).

Trade-offs for you to evaluate
- If you prefer per-node licensing, you'll keep flexibility for cluster changes but unit economics are higher initially.
- Site license gives predictability and lower marginal cost for scale, but is a longer commitment.

Next steps (proposed)
1) Helix confirms operator-seat model (per-node vs site) and which support band.
2) Redwood to send a pricing matrix (we'll include the discount/epp terms and both failover credit options).
3) If acceptable, commercial LOI and legal to exchange the SOW with the confirmed option.

Cc'ing David (legal pricing constraints) and Soojin (solutions/ops lead) so we can quickly size burst cost-share once you provide the traffic sample.

–Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@helixtx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Helix Procurement <procurement@helixtx.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 07:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private Stack: starter commitment, support bands, and failover credit request

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the helpful details. Summary of the commercial position we can commit to in an LOI if Helix confirms by 12/20:

Agreed commercial outline (to be reflected in SOW)\- Pilot term: 6 months starting on onboarding signature.
- Licensing: option A (per-node): 6 operator seats mapped to your 3 clusters = $24,000/month reserved (pilot rate).
- Platform fee: $12,000/month with a 12% pilot discount and a 3% early-pay incentive available (combined net 15% if invoiced and paid within 15 days).
- Support: Enhanced (24x7) selected — uplift +22% of platform fee.
- Failover credit: Option A (one-time first-month platform fee credit) on executed SOW; engineering testing window to be scheduled within onboarding plan.

Attachments: I've asked legal to prepare a short LOI and asked Marissa to include the final pricing grid. Once Helix confirms operator seat approach, Soojin will lead the technical sizing call to lock burst costs.

Jordan — thanks for offering the co-marketing quote; that helped close the gap on discountability. If procurement is aligned, we'll circulate the LOI and redline-ready SOW by Monday.

Best,
Evelyn
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
